messages:
maria: heads up — hitting a weird TS typing regression when using the js-sdk from an ESM app that targets the edge runtime. method overloads with generics collapse to any. repro attached
chris: hmm, can you paste minimal snippet? are you bundling? tsconfig?
maria: here's the call site:

```ts
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'

const c = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })

// overload resolution picks the wrong overload, generic inferred as any
await c.generate('summarize', { model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'TLDR: ...' })
```

and tsconfig has `module` = "esnext", `moduleResolution` = "node", target es2020, `type`: "module" in package.json. bundler is esbuild
alex: does the sdk publish cjs + esm? we've seen node ESM vs edge build differences — edge runtime needs ESM and different d.ts . Are you using the packaged types or local dev build?
maria: installing from npm, v2.4.1. node resolves to esm entry but the types in dist/ are commonjs-style overloads that rely on `declare function` merges — TS seems to prefer the any overload in a bundler/edge context
priyanka: maybe related to `unknown` vs `any` in overload signatures? if one overload uses `unknown` and the other `any`, ts widens to any in some resolvers.
chris: quick check: can you try adding `--skipLibCheck` or set `moduleResolution: 'bundler'`? also try `import type` to force types-only import and see if inference improves
maria: skipLibCheck helped a bit but not ideal. moduleResolution: 'bundler' fixed it locally but we can't require customers to change tsconfig. repro repo: https://github.com/maria/repro-rw-typing (private)
alex: thanks — creating a tiny test in our CI to run TS 5.2 + esbuild + deno/edge bundling. if we can reproduce we'll patch the typings
priyanka: short-term: publish a patch that makes overloaded generics explicit by adding a discriminant param or narrowing the overloads so TS doesn't fallback to any
maria: sounds good. also noticed `exports` vs `main` in package.json causes consumers to pick the CJS types in some packagers. maybe we need "types": {"import": "./dist/esm/index.d.ts", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.d.ts"}
chris: filing issue #4123 and linking the repro. tagging @devx-bot for tracking
devx-bot: Issue created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVX-4123 — assigned to eng-ml; priority P2 :spiral_note_pad:
priyanka: I'll draft a patch and add a unit repro in devex tests. ETA EOD tomorrow
maria: thank you! will add our app's traceback and a minimal failing compile log
alex: if PRI ok, we should also add an entry in the SDK upgrade notes about tsconfig caveats for edge users
maria: :thumbsup:
